design.lane_1: Repeat independent 600-entry gate-profile comparisons against all 348 canonical WikiPron language profiles.
design.lane_2: Test whether a predeclared Romance set is enriched versus 10,000 random same-size language sets.
design.lane_3: For each reconstructed meaning, hold one broad family out of its evidence, predict a medoid path from the remaining families, and score the held-out family. This prevents the target family from directly defining its own prediction.
design.primary_boundary: Similarity is structural evidence, not proof of genealogical origin.

interpretation: Romance languages are significantly enriched for high similarity under the 20-shard gate-profile test.
Occitan ranks 1.20 on average versus Latin 20.10; the reconstruction is therefore more similar to the tested modern Occitan profile than to the tested Latin profile.
Old Spanish mean rank 12.60 versus Occitan 1.20.

This experiment can identify a Romance/Indo-European structural signal but cannot by itself establish that Latin or any Romance language is the historical ancestor of all human languages. The reconstructed dictionary was built from multilingual evidence, so the held-out-family lane is included as a circularity check.
